title: StreamForge hub source registry
description: The manifest a StreamForge Hub reads from a public GitHub repository. Version 1. Only the keys listed here are understood: an unknown key makes the whole document be refused rather than silently ignored, so a typo can never look like a working entry.

schema_version.description: Must be exactly 1. A newer version is refused, so an older hub never half-understands a newer document.

name.description: A human name for the repository.

sources.description: Up to 64 sources, 5000 entries each, 20000 entries in total.

id.description: Stable source id. It owns the entries it contributes: disabling or removing the source removes only its own rows.

type.description: provider = references resolved by a plugin; m3u = a playlist; movies/series = a JSON collection; hls = direct media URLs.

provider.description: Required for type=provider. One of the hub's provider ids: rutube, dailymotion, snrt, forja, iptvorg, my2m, quran, bilibili.

category.description: Group title entries of this source are listed under. Defaults to name, then id.

path.description: A path inside the repository, relative and free of '..'. Required for m3u, movies and series; optional for provider and hls (which otherwise take an inline items array). Declaring both path and items is refused.

media_type.description: The media type the source's entries have when they do not declare one. This is how an M3U file can say 'these lines are films'.

enabled.description: A disabled source contributes nothing and its entries are removed from the catalog.

reference.description: Either a public media URL (http/https, no credentials, no private or loopback address) or a provider reference (https page URL on a provider's host, or <provider>://<content-id>).

url.description: Accepted as an alias of reference.

media_type.description: Defaults to the source's media_type, then to what the source type implies.

logo.description: Accepted as an alias of poster (the M3U vocabulary).

group.description: Accepted as an alias of category (the M3U vocabulary).

series_id.description: Groups an episode under one series row. Without it an entry is a row of its own.
